name: ASTERIAL
releaseNotes: Complete v1.4.5 full-stack messaging & social reconstruction: deep-charcoal workspace (#090A0C / #101216 / #171A20), selective accent themes (Indigo, Cobalt, Emerald, Amber, Monochrome), System auto-theme, and customizable chat wallpapers.

Upgraded core messaging workflows across Web & Android: message pinning & unpinning, multi-conversation message forwarding, voice-note recording & playback, inline video/document previews, per-chat draft preservation, unread dividers, and scroll-to-latest navigation.
Personal Close-Connections Orbits & Community Spaces: private owner-isolated Inner Circle and Priority contacts with instant chat launch, live presence, and Orbit-only Moment & Feed audiences.
Unified authorized workspace search (⌘K / Discover) across People, Conversations, Groups, Messages, Moments, and Feed posts, backed by typed domain service modules and strict PostgreSQL RLS.
